Whether you need guidance on selecting a suitable quiet workspace or a discussion on acoustic measurement in our booth, we're here to help you make informed decisions that enhance your staging work environment and office productivity.

settings.title: What makes an office phone booth different from traditional office dividers?
settings.text: Unlike traditional office dividers that can be static and limit flexibility, our office phone booths and office pods offer a dynamic approach to modern office design. They provide a private and soundproof environment for meetings, calls, and focused work, all while being adaptable to changing office layouts. With customisable options, portability, and acoustic control, our solutions elevate workspace functionality and aesthetics.

settings.title: Which office phone booth should I get for my office space?
settings.text: Selecting the ideal acoustic solution depends on your specific needs and office layout. Consider factors like the size of your team, the types of activities you'll use the office pod for (private calls, meetings, focused work), and your office aesthetics. Our range includes various models such as the Folio Office Phone Booth, Quell Flex Office Phone Booth, and Quell Acoustic Office Phone Booth. Reach out to our experts for personalised recommendations based on your requirements.

settings.title: Are acoustic phone pods easy to install and move if needed?
settings.text: Absolutely. Our acoustic phone pods and booths are designed with ease of installation and mobility in mind. They come with clear assembly instructions, and many models feature wheels or castors for effortless movement within your office space. If you're planning to relocate, our pods can be dismantled and rebuilt at your new location, ensuring that your investment remains flexible and adaptable.

settings.title: What is the key advantage of having a Acoustic 2 person office pod?
settings.text:
The Quell Midi 1-2 Person office phone booth offers unparalleled flexibility and adaptability to suit your unique needs.

Whether you require a private workstation, a focused meeting room, or a space for sales training, this booth transforms to meet your demands.

With multiple furniture options, electrical desk capabilities, and an elegant design, it elevates both productivity and aesthetics in your workspace.

settings.title: How do I pick the right furniture configuration for my two person pod?
settings.text:
Choosing the optimal furniture configuration depends on your specific requirements.

If you value ergonomics and distraction-free work, the designer office chair and static ergonomically designed work desk might be ideal. Alternatively, if you seek a dynamic workspace with adjustable heights, the electrical desk option with memory settings could better suit your needs.

Our experts are available to guide you in selecting the configuration that aligns with your workflow.

settings.title: Can your two person pods be customised to match my office's aesthetics?
settings.text: Absolutely. The Quell Midi Office Phone Booth is designed to seamlessly integrate into various office aesthetics. Its versatile design allows it to complement your chosen style, whether that's a minimalist, contemporary, or classic look. This booth enhances the overall appeal of your workspace while providing the functional benefits you seek. Explore the range of options to find the perfect fit for your office environment.

settings.title: Power supply set up, do we need to do any thing?
settings.text: No. All our booths come with a 13amp power supply which plugs into the side of the booth with standard insert. Plug into your wall socket with locally supplied wall plug. If you are purchasing in UK, Europe or the US you will be supplied with local wall socket and correct electrical certificated components CE / UL Certificated.

settings.title: How do the meeting and phone booths connect to power?
settings.text: Our meeting and phone booths require simple installation, we recommend using our professional installation team. Each booth features a built-in power inlet on the side with an integrated 13-amp fused spur. Once assembled, the included 2-metre cable simply plugs into a standard mains socket, making setup simple.

settings.title: Is special electric power supply required?
settings.text:
All of our meeting and phone booths are plug and play, meaning once built there is an insert for a 13amp cable on the side of the booth which approximately 2 metres long. This is the simply plugged into your normal power socket.

(UAE, UK / USA, Euro, Swiss supplied depending on the delivery address.)
